t: This is Hyde Park Corner station, on the Piccadilly line between Knightsbridge and Green Park, in fare zone 1. It stands near Hyde Park Corner, at the edge of Hyde Park. The station was designed by Leslie Green, an English architect. He is best known for the Underground stations he designed in central London in the first decade of the twentieth century. They have distinctive oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars and semi-circular first-floor windows, with patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style. Green died in 1908, so these stations are the heart of his short career.
